commit_message: Remove synchronous ACP startup compatibility path
pr_title: Keep AI Studio responsive during ACP startup
pr_body:
## Summary

- remove the temporary synchronous ACP open helpers now that AI Studio uses prepared bindings and background startup
- remove the obsolete registered-runtime lookup error path
- record in ADR 0166 that presentation threads must not call blocking provider discovery/session opening directly

Remaining work is validation-driven formatting and compile fixes, followed by final Windows and Editor visual validation.
